evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies SQLite wallet storage and schema across src/wallet/sqlite.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp.
rationale: Transitioning SQLite transaction storage from flat key-value pairs to dedicated relational columns provides major architectural maintainability and unblocks sequential transaction ordering in #27865. As the PR notes, out-of-order database iteration causes 'numerous headaches due to the need to serialize multiple fields together' and loading in assigned transaction order simplifies reasoning about sequential transaction dependencies.
